inputs.text: These radical leftists can't protest without it spiraling into lawlessness every time. Their massive anti-Trump event started as a so-called "No Kings" rally but packed the streets and turned volatile fast, with agitators clashing against federal officers and forcing the police to step in with tear gas, arrests, and dispersal orders to restore basic order. At least 13 arrests were confirmed in Portland, Denver and... This is the predictable result when people reject authority, personal responsibility, and the social order that holds our traditions together.
